item.text:
[`test/orders.js`](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM\test\orders.js) defines four order helpers:

- `calcTotal(items)`: sums `price * qty` across line items
- `applyDiscount(total, code)`: applies `SAVE10` or `SAVE20`
- `averageItemPrice(items)`: divides the total by item count
- `formatOrder(order)`: renders line items plus a discounted total

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` has an off-by-one error: `i <= items.length` should be `< items.length`. As written, it reads `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`, so `items[i].price` will throw.
- `averageItemPrice` returns `NaN` for an empty `items` array because it divides by `items.length` without checking for zero.
- `formatOrder` depends on `calcTotal`, so it also breaks until the `calcTotal` loop bug is fixed.

If you want, I can patch the file and add a couple of focused tests.
